init_hubert_feature_reader: initialize a HubertFeatureReader with a checkpoint path, layer number, and optional CUDA flag
read_audio_wav: read an audio WAV file and return the waveform array with optional channel selection
extract_hubert_features: extract HuBERT features from an audio file using the get_feats method with chunked processing
run_hubert_inference: run HuBERT model inference on an audio file to get feature representations from a specified layer
normalize_audio_input: normalize audio input using layer normalization before extracting features from the HuBERT model
